memories.author: D05
memories.text: Vitamin D deficiency. Presents with fatigue and occasional muscle aches; BMI 22, vitals normal, chest clear. No smoking history. Plans: start cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks, then 1000 IU daily; check serum 25‑OH‑D, calcium, phosphate in 8 weeks; review in 3 months.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Cholecalciferol 60000 IU oral once weekly for 8 weeks.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2025-07-05 at 10:00 AM.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Vitamin D deficiency, improving. Reports better energy, no aches. Exam unchanged. Spirometry not indicated. Asthma Control Test not applicable. Technique not relevant. Smoking status never. Labs show 25‑OH‑D 22 ng/mL (target >30), calcium 9.1 mg/L, phosphate 0.9 mmol/L. Continue replacement, aim for maintenance.
